== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of Elis Helrot with the bronze errata disc, from the starwarsccg.org card lists; this file is the earliest archived copy, uploaded unchanged: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160807041059/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Dark/large/elishelrot.gif Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Elis Helrot (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]].
